title: Parkside Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Parkside is an amazing renovated luxury townhome in Seaside with an expansive rooftop deck that provides the most incredible 360-degree panoramic gulf views and sunsets! Five bedrooms with ensuite baths, 3 king suites & sleeps 13!
description_expanded: Description202 WEST RUSKIN PLACE3 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 1 BUNK ROOM (Queen over Queen bunk bed plus one twin trundle) Sleeps 13Luxury Parkside Living in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Parkside, an exquisitely renovated luxury townhome overlooking the iconic Ruskin Park in Seaside, Florida. This four-story penthouse has been completely taken down to the studs and reimagined with refined coastal elegance, modern finishes, and thoughtful design throughout. Comfortably accommodating up to 13 guests, Parkside offers an unbeatable location just steps from Seaside’s renowned shops, dining, and only a four-minute walk to the beach.Perfectly positioned along oak-lined Ruskin Park, this residence delivers both serene park views and effortless access to everything Seaside has to offer.Second-Floor Bedroom RetreatsThe second floor is dedicated to rest and relaxation, featuring four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each designed as a private sanctuary.The first king suite offers a plush bed dressed in crisp linens, a mounted flat-screen TV, a cozy seating area, and French doors opening to a private balcony overlooking Ruskin Park. The ensuite bathroom includes dual marble-topped vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in rain shower.The second king suite mirrors the same elevated comfort with inviting seating, a mounted TV, and a stylish ensuite bath with a single vanity and sleek glass shower.The third bedroom features a queen bed, soothing coastal tones, a large flat-screen TV, and a private bath with a tub/shower combination, ideal for unwinding after a beach day.Designed with families in mind, the fourth bedroom includes a custom queen-over-queen bunk with a twin trundle, sleeping up to five. This room also offers a bright ensuite bathroom with a tub/shower combination.Spanning the rear of this level is an expansive open-air balcony, furnished with cushioned loungers and club chairs—perfect for evening cocktails beneath the canopy of live oaks.Third-Floor Living, Dining & Gourmet KitchenThe third floor serves as the heart of the home, offering spacious gathering areas and an additional luxurious king primary suite.The open living room is outfitted with designer furnishings, including a generous sofa and plush accent chairs arranged around a large flat-screen TV—ideal for movie nights or relaxed evenings in. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats eight and flows seamlessly into the chef’s kitchen.The gourmet kitchen features a substantial stone island with bar seating for three, high-end stainless-steel appliances, a six-burner gas cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, warming drawer, beverage fridge, and abundant custom cabinetry. A nearby card table provides the perfect space for games, puzzles, or casual conversation.Step outside to the expansive third-floor balcony, where al fresco dining for eight, lounge seating, and a gas grill make entertaining effortless.Primary King Suite SanctuaryJust off the living area, the primary king suite feels like a private retreat. Juliette balconies overlook the treetops of Ruskin Park, bringing in natural light and coastal breezes. Inside, the suite features a sumptuous king bed, generous storage, and serene finishes.The spa-inspired ensuite bathroom includes dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed walk-in rain shower, creating a true luxury experience.Panoramic Rooftop Deck with Gulf ViewsCrowning the home is Parkside’s most show-stopping feature—a 1,600-square-foot rooftop deck accessed by a graceful spiral staircase. This incredible outdoor retreat offers 360-degree panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico, Ruskin Park, and Seaside’s picturesque rooftops.Fully furnished for relaxation and entertaining, the rooftop is the ultimate setting for sunset cocktails, morning yoga, or stargazing under the coastal sky.Additional Amenities & AccessibilityFor added convenience, an elevator is available upon request for guests with limited mobility and for transporting groceries and luggage.(Elevator is designated for luggage, groceries, and elderly guests only and is not intended for recreational use.)* 5 nights in Spring, Spring Break, & Summer; 3 nights in Fall and Winter. Guests must be 25 years or older to rent and sign registration.FEATURES5,226 square feet4-minute walk to beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, offering the largest stretch of private residential beaches on 30ATwo private parking spaces in a covered carport drivewayGas grillFull-size washer & dryer in a dedicated laundry closetElevator available for guest use upon requestEnhanced WiFi throughout the home with Eeros systemSub-Zero refrigerator & wine fridgePeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
